Mr. Shobhit Saharia, Advocate for the
petitioner.
2. Mr. N.K. Papnoi, Standing Counsel for
the State of Uttarakhand/ respondents.
3. Petitioner's father was em ployed as
Senior Treasury Officer and at the tim e of
his death, he was posted in District
Alm ora. After his passing away on
12.7.2020, petitioner applied for
com passionate appointment, which was
offered to him on the post of Junior
Assistant, which petitioner accepted,
though under protest.
4. I t is a fact that petitioner submitted
joining on the post of Junior Assistant on
18.9.2021 and thereafter he is serving
continuously as Junior Assistant. Petitioner
appears to have m ade an application for
appointment as Assistant Accountant as
per his educational qualification, on
com passionate ground.
5. Since his request for upgrading his
post to Assistant Accountant is not being
considered, therefore, petitioner has
approached this Court.
6. Learned State Counsel is right in
submitting that com passionate
appointment cannot be claimed as a
m atter of right and com passionate
appointment is given to dependent of
fam ily mem ber of a deceased employee to
tide over sudden financial crises. Learned

2026:UHC:416
State Counsel is also right in submitting
that com passionate appointm ent is not
given to a person, for m aking a career, and
it is given as a succour to the bereaved
fam ily so that they m ay bear the loss of
death of the sole bread-earner.
7. Since petitioner has accepted
appointment, which was offered to him as
Junior Assistant, therefore, there is no
question of upgrading his appointm ent to
the post of Assistant Accountant. I f
petitioner thinks that he is qualified and
suitable for appointment as Assistant
Accountant, then it is open for him to
participate in the open selection for
appointment to the post of Assistant
Accountant. He cannot seek
com passionate appointment on the post of
Assistant Accountant. The Dying-in-Harness Rules under which compassionate
appointment is given, also do not provide
for upgradation of a post.
8. Learned counsel for the petitioner
submits that other persons were given
com passionate appointment as Assistant
Accountant.
9. Merely because som eone else was
given compassionate appointment on a
higher post cannot be a reason for
petitioner dem anding similar relief. Thus,
there is no scope for interference in the
m atter. The writ petition thus fails and is
dismissed.
( Man oj Ku m ar Tiw ar i, J)
